Use the reference only for exact material style and palette. Output a square image split exactly into FOUR equal edge-to-edge square material swatches, no borders or gaps, no labels, no perspective and no objects. TOP RIGHT: weathered honey-brown old oak timber, dense vertical wood grain, dark cracks, worn pale edges within the grain, water stains, subtle moss/ochre grime, no plank frames, no added objects. BOTTOM LEFT: old forged dark iron and tarnished bronze mottled metal, rivet-free texture, scratches, rust freckling, edgewear as a flat mottled material. All swatches intricate, layered colors, physically credible surfaces, seamless repeating edges when possible. No heraldry, flags, emblems, text, shape silhouettes, casting shadows, 3D model, canopy or building. This is ONLY flat surface albedo material textures. Highest square resolution.
